radar-faers-bimekizumab.rationale: Retain with secukinumab as IL-17 psoriasis/arthritis biologic class context; current count is small and indication confounding is substantial.
radar-faers-bimekizumab.subject: BIMEKIZUMAB

radar-faers-cosentyx.rationale: IL-17 psoriasis/arthritis biologic reports may be class-context with bimekizumab, but small counts and inflammatory indications make it monitor-only.
radar-faers-cosentyx.subject: COSENTYX

radar-faers-denosumab.rationale: Denosumab is mentioned as a downstream bone-erosion intervention node, so retain the safety signal, but concomitants and osteoporosis context do not justify action now.
radar-faers-denosumab.subject: DENOSUMAB

radar-faers-nintedanib.rationale: Nintedanib has four informative reports with little co-reporting noise, but the cluster is too small and lacks a clear gout mechanism or primary-source task.
radar-faers-nintedanib.subject: NINTEDANIB

radar-faers-nivolumab.rationale: Small but relatively informative nivolumab cluster; captured indication fields had no matching gout/hyperuricemia term, but missingness remains unknown. Retain for recurrence or controlled immune-checkpoint safety context before action.
radar-faers-nivolumab.subject: NIVOLUMAB

radar-faers-oral-semaglutide.rationale: Semaglutide product reports support the queued GLP-1/GIP class check, but diabetes/CKD/obesity and concomitant drugs preclude a separate action.
radar-faers-oral-semaglutide.subject: ORAL SEMAGLUTIDE

radar-faers-repatha.rationale: Retain as PCSK9-target comparator context for the inclisiran queue; evolocumab reports alone are not enough for a separate action.
radar-faers-repatha.subject: REPATHA

radar-faers-risankizumab-rzaa.rationale: Retain as psoriasis/IL-23 biologic context because most reports are sole-suspect, but inflammatory disease comorbidity and lack of mechanism do not justify action now.
radar-faers-risankizumab-rzaa.subject: RISANKIZUMAB-RZAA

radar-faers-semaglutide.rationale: Semaglutide reports merit trend retention because a prior tirzepatide GLP-1/GIP signal is already monitored, but diabetes, weight change, and concomitant drugs preclude action now.
radar-faers-semaglutide.subject: SEMAGLUTIDE

radar-faers-tacrolimus.rationale: Tacrolimus/CNI renal-transplant context is biologically plausible but heavily confounded by kidney disease and co-medications; retain alongside prior CNI-class signals, no action yet.
radar-faers-tacrolimus.subject: TACROLIMUS

radar-faers-treprostinil.rationale: Prior PAH-therapy cluster recurs, but pulmonary hypertension, diuretic use, and comorbidity remain strong alternative explanations; retain for class recurrence only.
radar-faers-treprostinil.subject: TREPROSTINIL

radar-faers-upadacitinib.rationale: JAK-inhibitor reports are potentially relevant to inflammatory gout-adjacent biology, but arthritis/IBD/dermatitis indications and small counts make this trend-only.
radar-faers-upadacitinib.subject: UPADACITINIB

radar-faers-voclosporin.rationale: Prior voclosporin/CNI renal signal recurs, but lupus nephritis, kidney function, and co-medications remain strong confounders; retain for CNI-class trend.
radar-faers-voclosporin.subject: VOCLOSPORIN

radar-faers-vutrisiran.rationale: Two sole-suspect vutrisiran reports touch the siRNA modality surface, but ATTR disease context and tiny count make this monitor-only pending recurrence.
radar-faers-vutrisiran.subject: VUTRISIRAN

radar-faers-wegovy.rationale: Wegovy gout reports are retained as weight-loss semaglutide context for the queued GLP-1/GIP class check; no independent verification task is needed.
radar-faers-wegovy.subject: WEGOVY
